A descent into the {wiki:Ancient Temple|Ancient Temple}, beneath the north entrance of Thais, to the "Home of the dead Kingdom of Kormarak". After getting past poisonous gas, Minotaurs and a room full of {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} with a {creature:Demon Skeleton}, you find a corpse with a {item:Brass Armor}, a {item:Brass Helmet}, a {item:Hatchet} and 13 {item:Throwing Star|Throwing Stars}.
No Premium or minimum level required (15 recommended).
Daily respawn reward: only one character receives it per reset (server save).
or equivalent, so you do not get stuck if you take a wrong turn
Do the quest right after {wiki:Server Save|Server Save}: that is when you are most likely to find the reward still untouched.
Bring the {spell:Antidote} spell (or equivalent) for the poison gas room.
1. Going down to the Ancient Temple
Leave **Thais** through the **north** gate and go to the {wiki:Ancient Temple|Ancient Temple}, just **north-west** of that gate ({coord:32356,32171,7}). Go in and descend.
Ancient Temple map with the route to the quest
Go down the wooden stairs to the **north**. Follow the white line on the map through the dungeon and go down the next stairs.
You will find {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} and weaker orcs.
There is a room full of {item:Poison Gas|poison gas}, but you only have to cross **four** fields. Then go down the stairs.
Cast {spell:Antidote} so you do not keep losing health to the poison.

Below these stairs there are 3 {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs} and a few {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}. Head **north** following the line. You will find a sign: *"Home of the dead Kingdom of Kormarak. Enter and die!"*
Route to the kingdom of Kormarak
On the way you pass through a room with {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}: you can take the chance to do the {wiki:Ghoul Room Quest|Ghoul Room Quest}.
Go up the stairs. You may have to kill three {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} that appear there.
Go through the {item:Magic Forcefield}. On the other side there are **11 {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}** scattered around the room and a {creature:Demon Skeleton} that spawns at the back of the room.
The Ghoul room and the reward location
Use {item:Great Fireball Rune|Great Fireballs} to dispatch the Ghouls quickly and kill the Demon Skeleton with {item:Heavy Magic Missile Rune|Heavy Magic Missiles} while running away from it.
Open the {item:Dead Human|human corpse} next to the {item:Wooden Coffin|wooden coffin}. The reward is inside.
Brass Armor, Brass Helmet, Hatchet and 13 Throwing Stars

No exit shortcut is described: go back the **same way**. Leave the Ghoul room the way you came in, go down the stairs next to the Kormarak sign, follow the map line **south** to the Minotaurs' stairs and go up them. Cross the four {item:Poison Gas|poison gas} fields again and go up the stairs, follow the white line back and go up the wooden stairs to the surface. You come out next to the **north** gate of Thais.
Bring a {item:Rope}: the wiki recommends it so you do not get stuck if you take a wrong turn.
It is a {wiki:Daily Respawns|daily respawn}: if the corpse is empty, someone has already picked up the reward since the last reset.
